Suggestions and Requests for Service Improvement
(Dental Scaling Case)

2. Communication and Verbal Communication:
During the procedure, the therapist constantly pressured me, saying things like, "Don't swallow the water, it's tartar," or "My nose isn't covered, breathe through your nose." This made me feel tense and uncomfortable.

3. Listening to the Patient:
I was told to raise my hand if I had any problems, but when I actually raised my hand, they only said, "Just bear with it, it'll be over soon," without stopping to help or check if I had any issues.

* I paid for the service and expected better service and communication. I hope the clinic will take this into consideration and improve the standards of work and communication of the doctors or service providers.
